posts.title: The studio is open
posts.description: This is the studio: the place my projects share. Here they hang on one wall and stand on one desk. On the chalkboard is Purely Constructed , a typeface built from rules. Every letter is constructed, compass and straightedge, from one decorative P, then drawn along its center line with a round pen.
